text: Today, we officially roll out MiniMax M3.1 Flash . Space Bunny 🐰, which processed more than 200 trillion tokens while operating anonymously, was an early version of MiniMax M3.1 Flash. As a next-generation Flash model, M3.1 Flash delivers a generational leap in agentic tasks, coding, Computer Use and cybersecurity, while making online inference nearly three times faster and reducing usage costs by 70%. M3.1 Flash improves across a broad range of benchmarks, reaching the level of leading models in complex agentic tasks (cowork), computer use, software development (coding), and cybersecurity. Complex Tasks and Automation: Coding and Software Engineering: Computer Use: Cybersecurity: We have further optimized M3.1 Flash’s inference efficiency through more aggressive sparsity. In everyday use, output speeds can reach 200+ TPS (tokens per second), with median (P50) speeds consistently reaching 170+ TPS. For agentic tasks, the model’s overall usage cost is 70% lower than its predecessor. Flat pricing per 1M tokens: $0.15 input · $0.60 output · $0.015 cached input. Across three benchmarks—Automation-Bench for complex agentic task execution, DeepSWE for real-world coding, and Agents’ Last Exam (ALE) for computer use in real-world tasks with economic value—M3.1 Flash delivers performance on par with top models at a very low task cost, setting a highly competitive new standard for performance and cost. M3.1 Flash is now available through the MiniMax API, M Plan, and MiniMax Code. Model weights will be released later. Download MiniMax Code for desktop: https://agent.minimax.io/download Subscribe to M Plan: https://www.minimax.io/m-plan API access: platform.minimax.io Flash represents our ongoing exploration of the balance between efficiency and capability. Pro, which pushes the boundaries of intelligence, will also arrive later. Intelligence with Everyone.
